description: The user-journey taxonomy (the Successor Tech Lead Directive §13): the canonical journey vocabulary the program measures coverage against. Seeded from the public acceptance harness's own 12 journeys (tests/journey/journeys.ts — the same taxonomy the deployed plane is accepted by); the evolution program's RESCAN step may propose EXTENSIONS (a new journey enters the taxonomy through a governed work order, never by edit-in-place silently).

taxonomies.operator: the Lead's credentialed journey (deployment, verification, smoke)
taxonomies.developer: the agent-onboarding journey (machine artifacts, SDK, wire surface)
taxonomies.endUser: the console journeys (discover, capability, sandbox, execution, inspection, evidence, validation, compare, export, trust)

extensionRule: a NEW journey (e.g. a realtime-voice conversation journey once a real rail serves one) enters through a governed work order that extends the harness — the taxonomy file records the addition with its work-order id
